newsitem.title: ISRAEL: First privatisation round in Oct-Nov - Netanyahu.
newsitem.headline: First privatisation round in Oct-Nov - Netanyahu.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said in a newspaper interview his government would embark on its first round of privatisation in October or November.
"Privatisation is good for everyone in the economy and we intend to pursue it very aggressively," he told The Jerusalem Post, without giving any figures or naming companies to be sold off.
"In October-November we shall embark on the first round of privatisation. Most of the legal work is finished and we're ready to go," Netanyahu was quoted as saying.

The prime minister's office is currently preparing a four-year privatisation programme. Since taking office in June, Netanyahu has moved the Government Corporations Authority, which overseas privatisation, from the Treasury to his office.
